card.name: Ancestry phrases in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words and word parts inside ALL-CAPS label text, especially after 'patients' and before ancestry or ethnic terms like Chinese or Caucasian. Also fires on the colon after 'Keywords' in flag-site pages.
